items.title: Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2022
items.q: I mean look at Obama in a way.

ctx.x: Yeah well the donkey relieved himself on the way up to the stage. And you know the three wise men, you know it’s funny ‘cause like if you just put on your funny hat, they’ve got sombreros, it looks like the Three Amigos. But it’s in the reflective of the real tradition of “La Fiesta de la Posada” is about, it’s amazing what survived in the Bible, that you have you know Joseph and Mary, they’re not rich, they’re really poor, they’re refugees. That’s all set up, you know at least we have an open heart and kindness.…
He was born in a different country though. We all know that.
